title: Public Economics 2
duration: 3 credits (45 hours of class time, 105 hours of self-study)

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the concept and role of public finance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the concept and role of public finance.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing public finance policies based on four criteria (4E: Economy, Efficiency, Effectiveness, Equity)
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand and explain the analytical framework for public finance policies based on four criteria (4E).

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Measuring the scale of public finance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the measurement criteria and factors affecting the scale of public finance.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing models of public finance scale
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the nature of models used to analyze the scale of public finance.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding common issues in public expenditure, taxation, borrowing, and budget decentralization
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand common issues related to public expenditure, taxation, borrowing, and budget decentralization.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Modern standards of public expenditure management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand modern standards of public expenditure management and principles for evaluating public expenditures based on two types: capital and recurrent expenditures.
Students can analyze the impact of taxation from two perspectives: fairness and efficiency; basic principles of taxation and optimal tax theory.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Principles of borrowing and managing public debt
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand basic principles of borrowing and managing public debt, as well as the advantages and disadvantages of fiscal decentralization.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and evaluating current public expenditure, taxation, borrowing, and budget management policies in Vietnam
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can analyze and evaluate current public expenditure, taxation, borrowing, and budget management policies in Vietnam.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and evaluating major trends in public financial management reform globally and in Vietnam
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can analyze and evaluate major trends in public financial management reform globally and in Vietnam.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Reading, writing, presenting, and debating on topics related to public finance policy
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have the ability to read, write, present, and debate on topics related to public finance policy.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and synthesizing complex information related to public finance policy
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have the ability to analyze and synthesize complex information related to public finance policy.
Students have ethical awareness and professional responsibility.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Creative thinking and having a stance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have creative thinking and a stance; they know how to listen and think critically.
Students have the ability to actively participate in group activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Organizing, supervising, and inspiring members in performing assigned tasks and social activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have the ability to organize, supervise, and inspire members in performing assigned tasks and social activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Personal responsibility towards the group, community, and society
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have personal responsibility towards the group, community, and society.
